event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Defensive rotation; megacap tech cracked.
Q3 GDP printed 3.4% vs 3.2% fc and core PCE 2.5% vs 2.40% fc, re-steepening the hike narrative (Polymarket 72% for a Dec 9 +25bp) while Alphabet's cloud-driven earnings miss (GOOGL -12.64%) gutted mega-cap tech; capital rotated into small caps and defensives, not out of equities — RSP +1.20% vs SPY -0.38%. Breadth confirms a broadening tape even as the index falls.

INDICES — VIX 17.2, above its 16.8 20d MA, muted.
IJR +1.61%, IWM +0.97%, DIA -0.37%, SPY -0.38%, QQQ -1.42%, SOXX -1.55%. Small > large by 1.99pp. Most notable cross-asset move: TLT +0.62% and oil (USO +0.97%) firm while silver (SLV -3.63%) and gold (GLD -1.32%) fell hard. SPY/QQQ sit above 200-DMA — no CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — Concentration in small-cap and defensive names.
IJR punched 1.9x while IWM/IJH/SOXX faded (0.9x/0.8x/0.7x); XLV and XLC 1.6-1.8x, XLRE/XLU/XLE 0.8x — money flowed into healthcare and comms, away from defensives-plus-utilities. Up-volume on rising names = accumulation into broadening. S&P 500: 397/105 advance, 65% >50DMA, 62% >200DMA, up/down vol 1.61, 69 new 60d highs vs 19 lows — participation confirms.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLV Healthcare +2.40%, XLRE Real Estate +2.21%, XLP Staples +1.54%, XLU Utilities +1.53%, XLF Financials +1.44%, XLB Materials +1.29%, XLI Industrials +0.97%, XLY Discretionary +0.75%, XLE Energy +0.38%, XLK Technology -1.18%, XLC Comms -1.87%.
Top industries XHB +3.37%, ITA +3.16%; bottom IGV -3.52%, DRAM -4.38%. 5d flows show XLK +465mm (86p) and XLE +375mm (73p) bids vs XLF -1,310mm (2p) and XLU -756mm (0p) — money leaving financials and utilities despite their green day, so today's defensive pop is short-covering, not conviction. Real rotation is into tech-plus-energy; defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.57 = heavy protection demand; QQQ skew +3.4%, VIX 17.2 barely above 20d MA. VIXEQ 40.1 vs VIX 17.2 — a huge dispersion gap (low implied correlation), classic rotation/stock-picker tape. IWM PCR 0.35 = one-sided upside positioning.

CROSS-ASSET — Silver -3.63% and gold -1.32% selling while oil +0.97% and Treasuries +0.62% bid — a real-rates-higher chain that pressures metals, not risk-off. Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch 100% hike; Polymarket 72% YES for +25bp (5d -4pp).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 59.2, Neutral. NOW -26.95% (vol 6.1x, follows Alphabet cloud earnings read-through), HII +13.23% (vol 3.2x, AUKUS contract news), MRVL -13.24%, CAT -9.25% (vol 3.0x). Momentum: XLV best sector, XLK worst. Watch GOOGL -12.64% at 5.5x vol tomorrow, CAT -9.25% (equipment weakness vs XLI +0.97% divergence), and IWM at 0.35 PCR into the small-cap run.
